_note: PER-SEAT CLI INVOCATION RECIPES as DATA. Consumed by bin/run-brief.py (the DRY-RUN planner). The general LIVE executor that would shell resolved recipes is GATED and NOT built (see pipeline-graph.md); bin/grok-agent.py is the narrow standing-Grok exception and may run transport-only smoke, while every normal standing role remains hard-parked until its shared code-owned input binding exists. Keyed by PROVIDER id (config/providers.json) so a resolved seat maps straight to how it is invoked. `bin` is the CLI binary the planner would shell (null for app/api/local seats that have no CLI). `wrappers` maps a registry route `host` to the wrapper CLI its recipes MUST render (bin + prefix + exactly one model_flag followed by the route's exact invocation_id); doctor derives the expected argv from here plus the provider's route — never from prose. Direct `claude` is auth_blocked and fails closed whenever the provider route is absent, unresolved, or not live_verified. Detection of the underlying Claude CLI still lives in providers.json `detect.cmd`. `args_template` tokens render from the brief with {placeholders}. `reads` = what the seat consumes (code seats read the git diff; Visual QA reads the preview URL — AGENTS.md §Review). `never_metered_host` is the hard invariant AS DATA: true = a subscription CLI (included) the executor may shell; false = a metered third-party inference host that must NEVER be handed a diff/brief (secrets/PII ban, EDGE-CASES.md) — included capacity or owner-land only. bin/doctor.py ties never_metered_host to providers.json `billing` and `bin` to `kind`, so this file can never drift from the registry. Nothing here is policy — providers/families/order/economics live in providers.json + usage-windows.json.

placeholders.{brief_path}: path to the 6-field brief file (paths only, no pasted dumps — AGENTS.md §Brief)
placeholders.{worktree}: isolated worktree dir for an implement lane (1 lane = 1 worktree = 1 branch — DOCTRINE §Concurrency)
placeholders.{branch}: the lane's branch (review reads its git diff)
placeholders.{repo}: repo root for a review seat that reads the diff in place
placeholders.{preview_url}: visitor preview URL a Visual QA seat walks
placeholders.{agent_profile}: private staged byte-copy of the already validated standing Grok agent definition
placeholders.{sandbox_profile}: per-run unshadowable custom sandbox profile name

grok-bot-review-d.note: Named Grok CLI agent. Recipe argv is the staged custom-sandbox contract: --sandbox {sandbox_profile} immediately after the ephemeral CWD. The launcher generates a cryptographically unguessable mb-standing-<128-bit hex> name per run so a user-global profile cannot shadow it. The staged profile extends strict. Machine-owned --tools/--deny/--disallowed-tools/--disable-web-search/--no-auto-update/--no-subagents keep only local read tools and deny MCP, web, terminal, edit/write, and Agent spawn. When Grok 1.0.13 cannot resolve a known candidate symlink runtime-socket deny on macOS, the launcher sets restrict_network=false and denies every unique resolved non-symlink target from one code-owned candidate snapshot rather than falling back to workspace/read-only/off. Candidate and target identities are revalidated before inspect, immediately before provider start, and after completion; any change, unresolvable target, or non-macOS symlink PARKS. Transport-only smoke uses the frozen binary/auth/profile snapshot. Normal execution parks before prompt reads until a shared code-owned pixel-input binding exists; never Slack.

grok-bot-heat-map.note: Named Grok CLI agent. Same per-run {sandbox_profile} custom-sandbox and MCP/tool isolation contract as Review D. Same macOS-only Grok 1.0.13 symlink-socket workaround. grok-bot-marketplace-intelligence.note: Named Grok CLI agent. Same per-run {sandbox_profile} custom-sandbox and MCP/tool isolation contract as Review D. Normal execution parks before prompt/evidence reads until a shared code-owned authorized-deposit manifest exists; prompt-declared paths, classes, sources, and hashes are not authorization.
